introHtml: Auto open outdoor blankets save time and frustration at company picnics, trade shows, and team outings. With a simple toss, these blankets unfold themselves, so you can focus on your guests or clients. Choose from fleece, plaid, or roll-up styles with custom imprinting. Ideal for marketing directors who want a functional giveaway that gets used repeatedly.
